channel.title: Platform Ops — Tech with Vishal Abhinav
channel.description: Monthly deep-dives on Kubernetes, SRE, infrastructure and platform engineering — written from production, not slideware.

image.title: Platform Ops — Tech with Vishal Abhinav

item.title: #058 — OpenShift Architecture & Fundamentals
item.description: What the distribution adds on top of Kubernetes — the Cluster Version Operator ownership chain, projects and the project template, the operator pattern under CVO and OLM, MachineConfig, SCC admission, image streams and etcd — each with the failure mode it actually produces and how to triage it.
item.author: vishalabhinav.co.in@gmail.com (Vishal Abhinav)

item.title: #057 — Linux & Unix Glossary
item.description: 190 terms across 15 categories — fundamentals, permissions, processes, networking, storage, security, monitoring and troubleshooting — searchable in one place, with standalone deep-dive pages for the terms that need one.
item.author: vishalabhinav.co.in@gmail.com (Vishal Abhinav)

item.title: #056 — Linux Troubleshooting
item.description: A runbook, not a tutorial — high load and CPU, memory and OOM, disk and I/O, network, and boot failures, each with the commands to run and what their output means.
item.author: vishalabhinav.co.in@gmail.com (Vishal Abhinav)

item.title: #055 — Linux Advanced
item.description: systemd internals, kernel and sysctl tuning, namespaces and cgroups, performance profiling, and LVM.
item.author: vishalabhinav.co.in@gmail.com (Vishal Abhinav)

item.title: #054 — Linux Fundamentals
item.description: Filesystem hierarchy, users and permissions, package management, process basics, and shell scripting.
item.author: vishalabhinav.co.in@gmail.com (Vishal Abhinav)

item.title: #053 — Incident Management & Postmortems
item.description: Severity classification, the Incident Commander role, blameless postmortems, and action-item follow-through that actually closes.
item.author: vishalabhinav.co.in@gmail.com (Vishal Abhinav)

item.title: #052 — CI/CD & GitOps Deep-Dive
item.description: Jenkins and GitLab CI, GitOps with ArgoCD and Flux, security gates, canary and blue-green rollouts, and secrets management.
item.author: vishalabhinav.co.in@gmail.com (Vishal Abhinav)

item.title: #051 — Observability Stack Deep-Dive
item.description: Prometheus and Grafana, Loki and ELK, Jaeger and OpenTelemetry, and SLO burn-rate alerting that pages you for the right reasons.
item.author: vishalabhinav.co.in@gmail.com (Vishal Abhinav)

item.title: #050 — Kubernetes Storage Deep-Dive
item.description: PV and PVC, StorageClasses, CSI driver internals, StatefulSets, and a backup and DR strategy that's been tested.
item.author: vishalabhinav.co.in@gmail.com (Vishal Abhinav)

item.title: #049 — Kubernetes & OpenShift Error Runbook

item.author: vishalabhinav.co.in@gmail.com (Vishal Abhinav)
